source_to_consumer: Each scheduled time addresses the original predecessor. The complete dependent receipt pairs rooted material with the actual paid action material from that predecessor. Appending a row preserves every old receipt and strictly increases the address.

The paid state expression is evaluated in its own environment and collapsed through the original packet. All four branches contribute to the field. Original Q and fixed Fourier K take the price of that field.
The same scheduled prices form every column of the finite mixture. The existing sparse decoder recovers the old coefficients and the new coefficient from the prefix and one appended sample.

The decoded coefficients write the original complete Gamma2 graph and relation inventory forward. The direct consumer checks the original relation, whole, trace and literal next at the corresponding original ordinal.
